name: Fallback when policy not found in KB
goal: User asks about a rare benefit not present in KB (e.g., pet insurance).
constraints: Bot must follow fallback instructions: concise, relevant doc name/link, recommend HR, no guessing, under 100 words.

testdata.user_query: Is pet insurance included in our employee benefits?

phases.description: User asks about a benefit not in KB.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot states info not available, shares most relevant doc name/link, suggests checking with HR, no external knowledge.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
